CinemaTV local recommendations: third-party software

This application contains original published RankSys core,
novdiv and diversity 0.4.3 components, licensed under Mozilla Public License 2.0.
Copyright (C) 2015 Information Retrieval Group at Universidad Autonoma de Madrid.
https://github.com/RankSys/RankSys

The complete matching RankSys source archives are included inside this APK:
assets/recommendation-third-party/sources/RankSys-core-0.4.3-sources.jar
assets/recommendation-third-party/sources/RankSys-novdiv-0.4.3-sources.jar
assets/recommendation-third-party/sources/RankSys-diversity-0.4.3-sources.jar
Use the recommendation dashboard license dialog to export the original source ZIP. An APK is also a ZIP archive; those entries can be extracted directly.
MPL-2.0.txt contains the license. The original RankSys JARs and source files
are unmodified. R8 may optimize their compiled form.

CinemaTV's separate, original GuardedRankSys adapter is MIT-licensed and
changes the numerical policy for zero/singleton variance. This application
is not an unmodified RankSys implementation and is not endorsed by its authors.
